name: Default
shortDescription: Browser-based presentation editor built in Rust and WebAssembly: themes, shapes, charts, animations, slide shows and .pptx open, save and PDF export.

alerts.message: Presentations are not stored on the server: the web app runs in the browser and starts fresh on every visit. Save or export your decks to your own device before closing the tab.
The upstream project publishes no container image; this one is built by a community maintainer from the official releases.
